name: A square with no inertial sensor
description: A 36 in square on a four-motor 200 RPM base with no inertial sensor and no tracking wheels: position and heading both come from the drive encoders. The wheels scrub sideways in a turn, so each 90° turn really turns about 70° while odometry reads 90°. The four turns end 19.8°, 37.9°, 56.1° and 74.1° off and the last drive ends 36.3 in from its target. Change Heading to the inertial sensor and run again: every turn ends within 2.5° and every drive within 0.9 in.
